image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a cooked Dungeness crab placed on a platter. The crab features a large, rounded, reddish-orange carapace with visible texture and glossiness indicative of cooking. Two large claws (chelipeds) are prominent in the foreground, showing orange coloration with lighter joints. Several walking legs are tucked beneath or extending from the sides of the body. The background includes blurred elements of a meal, possibly vegetables or garnishes.
